subject: Request: Executive Sanction for VetCare Hosted API Rate (>25% discount)
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: VetCare opportunity — need exec sanction for deep hosted-API discount

Team,

Quick summary: VetCare (large regional vet chain; account contact: Avery Cole) is in procurement and asking for a one-year Hosted API commit with material upfront usage. They requested an aggressive commercial to beat a competing offer (Orion AI). Forecast attached — they project 38–45B generated tokens/month in year 1 across their triage/chat workflows (see VetCare-UsageForecast.xlsx).

Why this matters:
- ARR Year 1 opportunity ~ $1.2M with clear expansion path into Dedicated in 2029.
- Strategic: VetCare is a reference in animal health verticals; they run regulated PII-adjacent workloads and care about auditing + multi-region.

Request: Exec authorization to offer a one-year, volume-tiered hosted-API rate at 27% off list (flat percentage on text gen unit rates) for a 12-month committed spend. Our typical threshold for exec sign-off is >20% for this product — I need decision by EOD Fri 06/15 to keep procurement on track.

Proposed guardrails if approved:
- 12-month minimum committed spend (commit value in SOW).
- Prepay 50% on signature OR Net-30 with credit approved by Finance.
- Discount applies only to Hosted API list rates (no additional stacking with marketplace promos).
- First-month PO required before go-live; service starts after receipt.

Attachments: VetCare-UsageForecast.xlsx, Draft-SOW-v2.pdf (SOW has initial SLA and data residency notes).

Please advise next steps / final approval path. I recommend Ben + Karthik + Legal short review and Mina/Laura sign-off for the final authorization.

Thanks,
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: VetCare opportunity — need exec sanction for deep hosted-API discount

Agree with the ask and timeline — VetCare is strategic, and the usage profile is real (I spoke to Avery yesterday). A couple of notes:

- This is a high-ceiling account; their network of clinics means we get strong referenceability if they go live.
- Risk: token surge management during holiday adoption windows; recommend we require a safety cap and auto-notify if usage >120% of forecast.
- I support starting the approved range at 25% but happy to stretch to 27% if Finance gets the prepay or an irrevocable PO.

If Deal Desk needs a number for modeling, treat the baseline preferred discount as 25% with an up-to-2% incremental executive leeway tied to payment terms.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Enterprise Sales

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VetCare opportunity — need exec sanction for deep hosted-API discount

Thanks for the summary — a few clarifying questions before I take to Finance/Legal for impact analysis:

1) Can you confirm smoothing assumptions? Is the forecast front-loaded (month 1 = 60% of average) or even ramp? I need token cadence to model unit economics.
2) Payment term to support 27%: you mentioned prepay 50% or Net-30 with credit. If VetCare wants Net-30, Finance requires a payment guaranty or a 6-month rolling reserve.
3) Will we include a minimum committed tokens clause + overage pricing terms? Please confirm the overage rate we want once commitment is exceeded.
4) Legal: is the SOW currently including the audit+data residency language they requested (EU/US segmentation)? If not, legal will attach a redline and that will affect timeline.

Please upload the usage cadence (spread) and confirm payment preference. I'll prepare a short-deck for Mina/Laura with impact to expected margin and the conditional approval options.

-Karthik
Senior Deal Desk Manager

From: Avery Cole <avery.cole@vetcare.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 13:21:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: commercial — VetCare Hosted API commitment

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the quick follow-up. We are under a tight procurement cadence — our board approved vendor selection criteria is due next Wednesday. We can commit to a 12-month agreement if we receive a commercial that beats Orion's economic within their bid window.

Our preferences:
- Prefer net-30 with quarterly invoices (we can do a 50% upfront if required, but internal approvals favor Net-30).
- Must have a documented 99.5% SLA and month-by-month usage reporting + audit right for activity tied to PII processing.
- We expect a short SOW with clear acceptance criteria; we won't accept open-ended overage exposure without predictable unit pricing beyond the commitment.

If you can return a signed SOW with the commercial by Friday EOD (our local time), we will prioritize Redwood as our selection.

Best,
Avery
Director of Procurement, VetCare Health

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Avery Cole <avery.cole@vetcare.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Executive memo — approval requested (VetCare >20% discount)

Mina / Laura —

Short ask: Please authorize up to a 30% executive concession on Hosted API list rates for VetCare for a 12-month commitment, with final approval to be used as follows: primary recommendation = authorize 25% discount; conditional +2% (27%) if VetCare prepays 50% on signature; additional single-use executive leeway up to 30% only if they agree to a 12-month prepay and commit to a Dedicated evaluation in Q4 2028.

Why: Strategic reference in animal health + high likelihood of expanding to Dedicated in 2029, which materially improves unit margin for us. The volume forecast (attached) supports an attractive LTV despite the deeper first-year discount.

Proposed commercial guardrails (to mitigate downside):
- Minimum committed spend captured in SOW; overages billed at a clearly defined unit rate (we propose 12% higher than discounted rate).
- Prepayment preferred (50% on signature) otherwise Net-30 with finance-approved credit line + reserve.
- SLA: 99.5% for API endpoints (written into SOW).
- Quarterly business reviews and a Q4 evaluation decision on Dedicated.
- Auto-throttle and notification if monthly usage >120% of forecast; engineering to work with their infra team on burst support.

Option for decision (pick one):
A) Approve up to 25% discount; require Net-30 with Finance credit approval OR 50% prepay.
B) Approve up to 27% discount only if 50% prepay on signature.
C) Approve up to 30% discount only if 100% prepay and explicit agreement to evaluate Dedicated in Q4 (executive-only exception).

We need a decision by EOD PST Friday (6/15) to meet their procurement window. If you want a 1-page summary for Governance, I can send a two-slide memo with modeled margin impact.

Thanks for the quick read — Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Avery Cole <avery.cole@vetcare.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 17:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive memo — approval requested (VetCare >20% discount)

Thanks for framing this clearly, Jasmine. I reviewed the forecast + Ben and Karthik’s notes. Decision:

- Approve a 25% discount on Hosted API list rates for the first 12 months subject to the following mandatory conditions:
  1) 12-month committed spend captured in SOW (minimum commit = $900k ARR equivalent).
  2) Payment: Net-30 acceptable only with Finance credit approval; otherwise require 50% prepay at signature.
  3) Include SLA (99.5%) and audit/data-residency language in SOW; Legal to sign-off on redline before signature.
  4) Overages billed at 12% above the discounted unit rate; auto-notify triggers at 120% of forecast.
  5) Quarterly business reviews; require a Dedicated evaluation conversation in Q4 2028.

We will not approve >25% unless VetCare agrees to 50% prepay (27%) or 100% prepay + Dedicated evaluation (30%). If Jasmine secures prepay, escalate to me and I will authorize the incremental concession up to 27%/30% on a case-by-case basis.

Please proceed with Karthik to finalize the commercial table and have Legal push the SOW redline so we can turn this around to VetCare today.

-Mina Haddad
SVP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
